A concise reading guide to the original source, the discussion's attention signal, and the claims that still need verification.

The short version

Open-source ESP32 emulator. Run real firmware locally or in your browser — no hardware, no cloud, no subscription. - mikroverk/esp32sim

  • Author: joakimeriksson — official record
  • Discussion text: Hi HN, I’ve been working on esp32sim, an open-source ESP32 emulator that runs in the browser. The fun part of the demo is that there is no ESP32 involved — the firmware is executing in the emulator. The goal is to make ESP32 software easier to experiment with, test and simulate without always needing physical hardware connected. Source: https://github.com/mikroverk/esp32sim I made a short video showing it in action: https://youtu.be/waoWFilTWEc I’m particularly interested in feedback from embedded developers: what would an emulator like this need to support before you’d actually use it for development, testing or CI? — official record
